statement: The exact content-addressed Codex 0.149.1 Luna max structured-independent-review read-only realization is a bounded currentness hypothesis for the matching admitted runtime subject, permission profile, shell-read tool surface, and consumer fit query; it does not transfer the 0.148.0 pilot outcome or establish behavioral fit, proof, routing, activation, or acceptance.

conditions: the exact runtime_subject source and digest match the active abyss-stack runtime binding
the model identity, 0.149.1 realization configuration, Luna max effort, context, read-only permissions and landing-readonly-v2 tool profile match exactly
the active artifact admission and live catalog remain compatible with this exact subject at the time of any future canary
a new bounded real-work canary and independent review are required before any behavioral fit promotion
the generated fit query remains informational and cannot select, route, activate, prove, or accept a runtime
exclusions: transferring any Codex 0.148.0 behavioral fit, task outcome, reliability, handoff, wake, resume, or acceptance claim
substituting the current workspace-write realization for this read-only realization or treating permissions as interchangeable
using package admission, catalog compatibility, generated projections, or query output as activation, routing, process health, proof, or owner acceptance
claiming general Luna competence, autonomy, initiative, evaluator authority, or completion of the behavioral Goal
inferring closed-model internals, training data, or training lineage from runtime availability or behavior

evidence_refs.notes: Package identity and version only; not behavioral evidence.
Exact 0.149.1 runtime subject and current read-only shell-read profile; process activation remains outside this owner.

known_counterevidence.notes: The pre-delta exact 0.148.0 and 0.149.1 read-only fit queries returned zero candidates. This is infrastructure currentness pressure and is not behavioral counterevidence for the new realization.

freshness.policy: Reassess on any Codex version, exact runtime subject, package admission, live catalog, runtime profile, access, effort, context, permission, or tool-profile change; behavioral fit remains unestablished until a fresh reviewed canary.

history.reason: Current owner runtime evidence and the exact read-only realization configuration establish a bounded currentness candidate for the structured-independent-review consumer; the claim is intentionally not a behavioral or acceptance verdict.

attribution_limits: The exact subject and read-only permission profile are currentness inputs; package admission and process activation remain abyss-stack-owned.
The generated projection and exact fit query provide a content-addressed navigation result only; they do not authorize selection, routing, activation, proof, or acceptance.
The 0.148.0 read-only pilot evidence is not attributed to 0.149.1 and cannot establish behavioral fit for this candidate.
No behavioral rerun, independent review verdict, or ToS Goal acceptance is represented here.
No closed-model internal geometry, training data, or training lineage claim is made.
